WITH h AS (
  SELECT ds.rlink AS race_id,
         ds.acc_pt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY to_date(r.event_schedule->>'date_set','YYYY/MM/DD'), r.rak_id) AS races_done,
         (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date AS dob
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = ds.rlink
  JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = ds.drive_link
  WHERE d.driver_identity->'name'->>'first_name' = 'Lewis'
    AND d.driver_identity->'name'->>'surname' = 'Hamilton'
)
SELECT race_id,
       (acc_pt::numeric / races_done) / FLOOR((CURRENT_DATE - dob) / 365.25) AS dpv
FROM h
ORDER BY races_done

WITH mcl AS (
  SELECT r.yr AS year,
         cr.matchref AS race_id,
         c.namelabel AS constructor_name,
         cr.scoreval,
         cr.st_mark,
         r.rnum
  FROM constructor_results cr
  JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = cr.matchref
  JOIN constructors c ON c.cstr_key = cr.unitnode
  WHERE c.namelabel = 'McLaren'
)
SELECT year,
       race_id,
       constructor_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(scoreval,0)) OVER w
         * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st_mark IS NULL) OVER w)::numeric
         / (COUNT(*) OVER w) AS cumulative_cps
FROM mcl
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY rnum ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
ORDER BY year, rnum

SELECT location_metadata->>'name' AS circuit_name,
       (location_metadata->'coordinates'->>'elevation_m')::numeric AS elevation
FROM circuits
WHERE (location_metadata->'coordinates'->>'elevation_m')::numeric > 800
ORDER BY elevation DESC

SELECT r.event_schedule->>'event_name' AS event_name,
       d.driver_identity->>'reference' AS driver_ref,
       (9 - (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int)
         + CASE (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int
             WHEN 1 THEN 8 WHEN 2 THEN 7 WHEN 3 THEN 6 WHEN 4 THEN 5
             WHEN 5 THEN 4 WHEN 6 THEN 3 WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 8 THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END AS sprint_performance_index
FROM sprint_results s
JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = s.matchref
JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = s.unitdrive
WHERE s.sprint_performance->>'status_code' = '1'
ORDER BY sprint_performance_index DESC

SELECT AVG(FLOOR((to_date(r.event_schedule->>'date_set','YYYY/MM/DD') - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25)) AS avg_sprint_winner_age
FROM sprint_results s
JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = s.matchref
JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = s.unitdrive
WHERE (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG((9 - (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int)
         + CASE (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int
             WHEN 1 THEN 8 WHEN 2 THEN 7 WHEN 3 THEN 6 WHEN 4 THEN 5
             WHEN 5 THEN 4 WHEN 6 THEN 3 WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 8 THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END), 2) AS avg_spi_top8
FROM sprint_results s
WHERE (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int <= 8

WITH t AS (
  SELECT rbind,
         LEAST(
           CASE WHEN q1_r IS NOT NULL THEN split_part(q1_r,':',1)::numeric*60 + split_part(q1_r,':',2)::numeric END,
           CASE WHEN q2_r IS NOT NULL THEN split_part(q2_r,':',1)::numeric*60 + split_part(q2_r,':',2)::numeric END,
           CASE WHEN q3_r IS NOT NULL THEN split_part(q3_r,':',1)::numeric*60 + split_part(q3_r,':',2)::numeric END
         ) AS best_sec
  FROM qualifying
),
p AS (SELECT rbind, MIN(best_sec) AS pole_sec FROM t GROUP BY rbind),
sess AS (
  SELECT t.rbind,
         100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN t.best_sec - p.pole_sec < 0.2 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_specialists
  FROM t JOIN p ON p.rbind = t.rbind
  GROUP BY t.rbind
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pct_specialists), 2) AS avg_pct_qualifying_specialists
FROM sess

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dominant_victory_count
FROM (
  SELECT s.matchref,
         MIN(CASE WHEN (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1 THEN (s.sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::numeric END) AS winner_ms,
         MIN(CASE WHEN (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 2 THEN (s.sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::numeric END) AS second_ms
  FROM sprint_results s
  WHERE (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int IN (1,2)
  GROUP BY s.matchref
) g
WHERE (second_ms - winner_ms) / 1000.0 > 5
